items:
A work permit must be issued and maintenance 
 staff should carry the suitable safety category.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required.
Isolate the vessel from the feed water system.

Be sure that the heater has been completely 
 drained.
Check the pressure gauges show zero pressure.

Check thermometers and assure that temperature is 
 less than 38 C.

Provide adequate scaffolding lighting, platforms 
 or ladders.

Make certain that all safety tags are replaced 
 when maintenance and inspection are complete.
Complete maintenance tool set.
Cleaning articles (fluid, rags. etc)
Feeler gauge, suitable lifting device.

Internal inspection for evidence of 
 corrosion, scaling crack or broken or worn parts.

items: Valve must seat firmly and check for debris.

Valve nuts should be tight with no evidence of 
 leakage under gasket. If a disc appears to hang down, the spray valve can 
 easily be replaced.

Spray nozzle should likewise be checked for 
 foreign matter and see that all holes are clean and clear.

Check packing of controllers and valves, 
 replace if necessary.

Check man way gasket, replace if there is 
 evidence of leaks or deterioration of the gasket.

Check operation of all controllers; they 
 should move freely. Make any necessary adjustments, paying attention to the 
 overflow valve and controller as this is not used frequently and may have a 
 tendency to corrode and freeze into position.

Open and close all gate valves that have not 
 been used since last inspection.

Inspect thermometers, pressure gauges and any 
 other instruments.

Inspect all piping connection for corrosion. 
 Inspect insulation,

After unit is returned to service, oxygen 
 testing should be performed to ascertain that the vent setting is correct.

Introduction
This 
 document outlines the 
 equipment inspection list I1, to be performed on an annually bases 
 as indicated by Y1 in the above titled block.
The deaerator is used 
 to get red of the incondensable gases in the cycle and as a suction storage 
 tank for the feed water pumps.

Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued and maintenance

Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required.
Wear safety

A work permit must be issued and maintenance 
 staff should carry the suitable safety category.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required.
Isolate the vessel from the feed water system.
Be sure that the heater has been completely 
 drained.
Check the pressure gauges show zero pressure.
Check thermometers and assure that temperature is 
 less than 38 C.
Provide adequate scaffolding lighting, platforms 
 or ladders.
Make certain that all safety tags are replaced 
 when maintenance and inspection are complete.
Tools and Equipment
Complete maintenance tool set.
Cleaning articles (fluid, rags. etc)
Feeler gauge, suitable lifting device.
Work to be Carried Out
Internal inspection for evidence of 
 corrosion, scaling crack or broken or worn parts.
Spray Valve
Valve must seat firmly and check for debris.
Valve nuts should be tight with no evidence of 
 leakage under gasket. If a disc appears to hang down, the spray valve can 
 easily be replaced.
Spray Nozzles
Spray nozzle should likewise be checked for 
 foreign matter and see that all holes are clean and clear.
Check packing of controllers and valves, 
 replace if necessary.
Check man way gasket, replace if there is 
 evidence of leaks or deterioration of the gasket.
Check operation of all controllers; they 
 should move freely. Make any necessary adjustments, paying attention to the 
 overflow valve and controller as this is not used frequently and may have a 
 tendency to corrode and freeze into position.
Open and close all gate valves that have not 
 been used since last inspection.
Inspect thermometers, pressure gauges and any 
 other instruments.
Inspect all piping connection for corrosion. 
 Inspect insulation,
After unit is returned to service, oxygen 
 testing should be performed to ascertain that the vent setting is correct.
